title: TS-72 Tool-call events omit arguments, which makes audits hard
description: The turn event stream shows tool names and results but not arguments. Record arguments (redacting secrets) so a rehearsal or incident can be audited. Also: edit_workspace missing new_text error should say what to supply; write_workspace content gained a trailing newline versus what was sent (decide and document). Scenarios first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done in PR 507 (deployed): tool.call carries sanitised arguments and a summary, tool.result carries ok, summary, truncated output and duration; turn.thinking and computer.starting/ready added; contract in docs/MESSAGING.md. Verified live in the chat UI.

right_now_summary: The team is defining scenarios before adding redacted tool arguments and clarifying workspace behavior.
